description: Capybaras that look into space and enjoy telling stories.
summary: The project is a comic book that playfully addresses the interaction between three young astronauts and equipment left on Mars during different NASA missions. Upon coming into contact with the Curiosity rover, the story of this and other space exploration equipment is told so that children aged 9 to 12 can become familiar with what has already been accomplished in the search for knowledge about space, stimulating their interest in the subject. The comic book presented is intended to be the first in a series that will cover a wide variety of artifacts sent into space by humankind.
details:
The team's proposal for the challenge was the creation of a comic book that uses fiction, based on the journey of three young astronauts to Mars, to present to a children's audience, preferably from 9 to 12 years old, the history and information about the equipment sent for space exploration and reconnaissance. The option was made to present both the equipment still in operation and those that are already inactive.

The team believes that the format chosen to tell these stories is easily accepted by children and has the potential to encourage the search for more information about the equipment and missions presented.

The creativity of the project consists of the graphic and playful representation of a scientific and technological theme, with the creation of original characters and storyline, created by three 9-year-old boys, and integrated with real information about Mars exploration equipment.

The team considered, in choosing the challenge and the solution, factors such as: the age of the child participants, their knowledge and skills in drawing and writing, their interest in arts, astronomy and science in general, and the time available to carry out the Hackathon.

Technical details about the development of the project:

1 - Creation of the drawings

Drawings created directly on tablets.
Tool: ibis Paint X
Use of SI: none

2 - Comic book layout

Assembly of the comic book pages using the drawings produced individually.
Tool: Canva
Use of SI: none

3 - Video production

Assembly of the video using original images from the team and fonts, music, and resources provided by the editing software.
Tool: Adobe Express
Use of SI: none

4 - Video narration

Audio narrated by SI from original text created by the team.
Tool: ElevenLabs (https://elevenlabs.io/app/home)
Use of SI: narration

5 - Translation

Translation of the team's original text from Portuguese to English.
Tools: ChatGPT and Copilot
Use of SI: translation
